description: This Java source file defines the ResponderService class, an Android background service that handles incoming messages, generates responses using ElizaResponder, manages notifications, and maintains chat history for an Eliza chat application on wearable devices.

classes.name: ResponderService
classes.description: An Android Service that processes incoming messages, responds via ElizaResponder, manages notifications, and maintains chat history for wearable devices.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up the responder and broadcast manager, and processes any initial incoming message.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to process responses or retrieve chat history.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification with the latest response, including reply actions.

methods.name: processIncoming
methods.description: Processes incoming text, generates a response, updates chat history, and updates notifications.

methods.name: broadcastMessage
methods.description: Sends a broadcast message with the current chat conversation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels notifications when the service is destroyed.
